description: This file defines the ViewJobVacancyController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It extends an abstract controller to manage the view for job vacancy details, particularly setting up a Vue.js component named 'view-job-vacancy' during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: ViewJobVacancyController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling the view of job vacancies, setting up the Vue.js component for rendering the vacancy details.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes a Vue component named 'view-job-vacancy' before rendering the page.
